items.title: EBAY Q3 deep dive: broad-based growth, strategic investments, and AI drive marketplace momentum
items.summary: Online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 13.7% year on year to $3.21 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $3.22 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.51 per share was 6.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
